title: Malta Guinness内在力量广告
author: أداة توليد أوامر الذكاء الاصطناعي
categories: 产品营销,海报 / 传单,摄影,电影感 / 电影剧照,产品,美食 / 饮品,角色
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a premium conceptual FMCG beverage advertisement for Malta Guinness, communicating inner strength, nourishment, vitality, and energy through a dramatic product reveal.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, centered composition, warm monochrome golden-yellow studio background with a subtle floor shadow and soft gradient lighting. Use high-end commercial product photography realism, Cannes Lions advertising craft, minimal Apple-like art direction, crisp typography, and cinematic contrast.

Main subject: Place exactly 1 cold aluminum beverage can in the center, upright and front-facing. The can is golden on the upper two-thirds and deep dark red on the lower third, covered with realistic condensation droplets. Add metallic rim highlights, realistic can curvature, and a grounded shadow beneath it.

Product branding and label details: On the can, show the Guinness harp icon above the large word “Malta,” with “GUINNESS” underneath. The lower red section contains exactly 3 benefit words separated by dots: “VITALITY · GOODNESS · ENERGY,” plus a small barley-like icon and the line “NON ALCOHOLIC MALT DRINK.” Keep all label text sharp and legible.

Conceptual reveal: Across the middle of the can, create exactly 1 horizontal torn-paper opening ripped through the label, with rough fibrous edges and curled paper flaps extending to the left and right. Inside the torn opening, show exactly 1 silhouetted athlete sprinting forward through glowing amber light, dust, and radiant sunburst beams, suggesting strength coming from within the drink. The interior scene should be cinematic and bright, contrasting with the realistic can exterior.

Text content: Add exactly 2 headline blocks outside the can. At the top, centered above the can, write “nourishment” on the first line and “that strengthens” on the second line, with “strengthens” in bold dark type. At the bottom, centered below the can, write “real strength” on the first line and “starts within” on the second line, with “within” in bold dark type. Use a clean modern sans-serif font, lowercase styling, dark brown/near-black color, generous spacing, and no extra copy.

Visual style: Hyper-real product advertising, warm golden palette, dramatic backlighting, shallow studio depth, immaculate retouching, tactile torn-paper texture, condensation detail, elegant minimalist layout. The mood is empowering, nourishing, premium, and universally understandable.

Constraints: Include exactly 1 can, exactly 1 torn opening, exactly 1 runner silhouette, exactly 2 external headline blocks, and exactly 3 benefit words on the label. Do not add hands, people outside the torn opening, extra products, splashes, fruit, ice cubes, logos beyond the can branding, watermarks, or additional text.\

title: 照片到动漫素描比较网格
author: @CHERRY 2.O
categories: 社交媒体帖子,信息图 / 教育视觉,摄影,草图 / 线稿,动漫 / 漫画,肖像 / 自拍,群像 / 情侣
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a 2-row by 4-column comparison grid showing a transformation from realistic child and teen portrait photos into cute 2D anime-style sketch drawings.

Canvas: Square vertical-ish social media image, clean white background, 4 equal columns separated by thin white gutters. The top row is full-color realistic photography; the bottom row is black-and-white line art. Each column pairs one person above with their matching cartoon sketch below.

Layout: Use exactly 8 panels total: 4 realistic portraits in the top row and 4 corresponding manga sketches in the bottom row. Crop all subjects as front-facing bust portraits, centered in each column. Keep the top row photographic and softly lit; keep the bottom row as clean black ink line art on white with no color fill.

Top row subjects, left to right: 1) a young girl with a straight dark brown bob haircut and blunt bangs, gentle smile, beige coat over a white shirt, softly blurred outdoor background; 2) a teenage boy with messy tousled brown hair, subtle freckles, relaxed smile, black hoodie, neutral indoor background; 3) a teenage girl with long wavy light-brown hair, blue-green eyes, soft smile, cream knit top and small pendant necklace, warm neutral background; 4) a little girl with light brown pigtails tied with pink hair ties, bright toothy smile, pink sweater under denim overalls, green outdoor bokeh background.

Bottom row sketches, left to right: 1) matching anime girl with bob haircut and bangs, large sparkling eyes, open cheerful smile, blazer-like coat and shirt; 2) matching anime teen boy with spiky messy hair, big eyes, small smile, hoodie with drawstrings; 3) matching anime teen girl with long flowing wavy hair, large eyes, open smile, knit neckline and pendant necklace; 4) matching anime little girl with twin pigtails, big round eyes, open happy smile, sweater and overall straps with buttons.

Visual style: The photo row should look realistic, high-resolution, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field, soft daylight. The sketch row should look like polished Japanese manga/anime character line art, adorable proportions, oversized eyes, expressive faces, clean varied line weight, minimal shading, white negative space.

Constraints: No captions, no logos, no watermark, no extra people, no additional panels. Preserve the exact 4-column pairing and make each sketch clearly reinterpret the person directly above it. Use realistic children and teenagers transformed into cute anime sketches, with a wholesome magical childhood feeling.\

prompt_en: Create a vertical 2:3 cinematic retro editorial portrait of a young woman with long black wavy hair, pale skin, delicate facial features, and a cold melancholic gaze, leaning against an old corner wall covered with yellowed vintage newspaper clippings and faded retro posters. She wears a dark gothic lolita-inspired outfit: black velvet dress or jacket, white ruffled lace collar, white lace shoulder trim and cuffs, plus a long dark beaded cross necklace. Her expression is distant, tired, slightly sorrowful and untouchable, with parted lips and soft smoky eyes, looking directly at the viewer from a close three-quarter angle. Use soft-focus analog film photography, muted beige-gray tones, dusty sunlight from the upper left, shallow depth of field, visible film grain, scratches, haze, static noise, and slightly faded colors. The room should feel cramped, nostalgic, and decayed, with peeling paper texture and blurred posters in the background. Add exactly 6 small white typewriter-style English text overlays integrated into the image like avant-garde magazine typography: 1) near the upper left wall, “STATIC / FACE”; 2) mid-right, “NOISE / PRAYER”; 3) below it, “// / QUIET / THREAT”; 4) lower left near her shoulder, “EYES OPEN. / TRUTH CORRUPTED / BEYOND THE NOISE.”; 5) bottom left, “// / FALSE”; 6) faint horizontal glitch lines and tiny unreadable static marks around the frame. Keep the woman as the clear subject, crop from chest upward with one arm softly entering the lower right foreground, and avoid modern objects, bright colors, smiling expression, or clean digital sharpness. Customize the mood as do not come close, but you cannot stop looking.\

Light the scene with a professional studio setup: a soft front key light, subtle fill to preserve gentle shadow detail, and a faint rim light for separation. Place her against a clean smooth studio backdrop in a soft warm beige-gray neutral gradient with no distractions. Keep skin tones accurate and realistic, color grading natural and balanced, post-processing minimal, and overall styling like a modern editorial fashion portrait in casual streetwear, ultra-detailed, clean, and photorealistic.\

prompt_en: Create a wide sticker-style fan poster featuring a young male streetwear model sitting casually in the center on a clean white background. The central figure is a black-and-white cutout photo effect with a deliberately blurred/obscured face, wearing a black baseball cap, black oversized T-shirt, loose dark jeans, white socks, black-and-white sneakers, a chain necklace, and a wristwatch; pose him seated on the floor with legs spread forward, one elbow resting on a knee and one hand near his head, relaxed idol streetwear energy. Surround him with bold blue, orange, pink, and black hand-drawn doodle stickers and graffiti typography in a playful Gen-Z aesthetic. Include exactly 17 visible doodle/text elements around the person: 1 large blue graffiti word “OOTD” on the left with a black shadow and a small black ribbon underneath reading “OUTFIT OF THE DAY”; 2 a blue crown above the OOTD; 3 a small “GOOD VIBES” note with a pink heart near the top center; 4 an orange comic burst on the upper right containing “COOL”; 5 a large blue oval sticker on the right reading “TODAY” with a pink heart; 6 black handwritten “STYLE” with pink “UP!” beneath it on the lower right; 7 a large blue star at bottom right; 8 a blue lightning bolt at top right; 9 an orange spiral squiggle at the far upper right; 10 a small black squiggle near the right edge; 11 a black curved arrow pointing upward near the right middle; 12 a loose blue wavy scribble near the lower right center; 13 a blue underline scribble beneath the shoes; 14 an orange speech bubble on the lower left reading “NICE!”; 15 black text “BE YOURSELF” with a blue underline on the left; 16 a blue outlined star on the left; 17 a pink lightning doodle near the lower left. Add a few short black motion marks around the stickers but do not add extra labeled stickers. Use thick marker outlines, energetic hand lettering, high contrast, crisp cutout edges, slight gray floor shadow under the seated person, clean modern collage composition, blue-green/blue-dominant sticker vibe with orange and pink accents. title: 极简单线社交媒体头像
author: 小小东
categories: 头像 / 个人资料,草图 / 线稿,极简主义,肖像 / 自拍,动物 / 生物
prompt_en: Please transform the input image into a minimalist single-line illustration suitable for social media avatars, with a default aspect ratio of 1:1. The subject can be a person, cat, dog, other animals, or plants. Based on the input subject type, automatically extract the most recognizable outer contours and key features, and summarize them into an artistic, minimalist single-line avatar/image illustration. The overall goal is not mechanical outlining, but retaining the subject's charm and recognizability, reconstructing it with higher elegance and spirit through single lines. [Subject Processing Logic] If the subject is a person: retain key contours such as face shape, forehead, bridge of the nose, mouth transitions, chin, ears, hairstyle, keeping only necessary facial features to avoid cluttered details. If the subject is an animal: retain head shape, ears, muzzle contours, eye expressions, and the main flow of fur to avoid complex details. If the subject is a plant: retain the most recognizable morphological features of flowers, leaves, branches, or fruits, summarizing their posture and rhythm with simple lines. [Line Style Requirements] Lines must be smooth, rounded, stretched, bold, and natural, as continuous as possible, with a sense of breath and improvisation. Use soft arcs mainly, avoiding sharp, stiff, or rigid lines. Do not draw as a rigid logo-style outline. Lines should be simple but vital, with a touch of casual artistic flair, looking relaxed and collectible. [Composition and Avatar Adaptation] 1:1 square design. The subject should be clear, concentrated, and prominent. Centered or slightly centered composition with clear visual focus and sufficient white space. [Background Logic] Do not fix the color to one type (not always blue). Select dark-toned background logic based on the image's temperament. Avoid neon or cheap bright colors. [Line Color Logic] Use thin white lines or light-colored lines contrasting with the background. [Embellishment Logic] Add small, random, colorful dots, arcs, stars, or geometric symbols to enhance spirit and fun. Keep them sparse and natural. [Overall Goal] Minimalist, light, modern, and artistic. Suitable for social media: eye-catching, recognizable, and fun. [Avoid] Realism, shadows, textures, complex scenes, mechanical outlining. Ratio 16:9\

prompt_en: Create a breathtaking surreal cinematic digital artwork of a young adult man floating weightlessly above a massive city rooftop at night, viewed in a vertical 3:4 frame. The man is positioned slightly left of center, reclining horizontally in midair as if gravity has stopped: torso leaning back, head near the upper-left center, one arm hanging down, knees bent, legs extending toward the right, wearing a dark charcoal long overcoat, gray hoodie, black pants, and black-and-white sneakers. Use a realistic but dreamlike composited style with dramatic depth of field and soft motion blur. The background is a dense modern city skyline with high-rise buildings, glowing windows, bokeh streetlights, and a low rooftop ledge across the bottom third. The sky is deep navy blue and full of tiny stars. Fill the sky with exactly 96 glowing warm orange paper sky lanterns: 9 large close lanterns around the edges and upper sky, 27 medium lanterns scattered across the upper and middle sky, and 60 small distant lantern lights receding into the background in loose diagonal streams. Add exactly 22 small orange ember streaks drifting in the lower half of the image, plus a faint smoky haze over the rooftop surface. Lighting should come mainly from the lanterns, casting warm amber highlights on the man’s coat and shoes while the city remains cool blue-gray. Emphasize scale, wonder, and levitation, with the largest lantern near the center-right glowing brightly and the man suspended above the blurred urban nightscape. No text, no watermark, no extra people.\

Minimalist, balanced layout. Top title at top: 'Pencak Silat Choreography – 16 Counts – 10 Seconds – Smooth Flowy Chill'.

Panel 1: wide ready stance, knees bent, one hand guarding forward, focused expression.
Panel 2: step forward with outward block, arm extended defensively.
Panel 3: inside block sweeping upward diagonally, torso rotating.
Panel 4: strong straight punch forward, aligned hips.
Panel 5: side step into low stance, both hands pushing outward.
Panel 6: knee lifted high in chamber position, balanced posture.
Panel 7: front kick extended forward, opposite arm guarding.
Panel 8: step backward into defensive cover, arms crossing.
Panel 9: low block, sweeping arm downward in deep stance.
Panel 10: hook punch across body with hip rotation.
Panel 11: turning body with pivoting feet, circular motion.
Panel 12: forward palm strike, stable stance.
Panel 13: low sweeping motion near ground in squat stance.
Panel 14: rising smoothly from low stance, upward motion.
Panel 15: controlled locking pose, one arm raised defensively.
Panel 16: closing salute, feet together, hands pressed at chest, calm posture.

Include hand-drawn arrows (blue and purple accents), clean infographic layout, evenly spaced panels, consistent character design across all frames.

A focused male martial artist performs a smooth, flowing Pencak Silat sequence in a minimalist studio. He is in his late 20s, athletic build, medium height, warm tan skin, with thick wavy dark hair and a short, well-groomed beard. He wears a fitted deep red button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearms, beige slim-fit pants with slight wear at the knees, and clean white sneakers. His expression is calm, controlled, and intent. 
The setting is a softly lit neutral studio with an off-white textured backdrop and a slightly worn wooden floor. Lighting is diffused and cinematic, creating gentle shadows and emphasizing fluid motion.
The choreography is continuous and rhythmic, with no abrupt cuts: 
0–2s: Starts in a grounded ready stance, knees bent, one palm forward in guard, eyes locked ahead 
2–4s: steps forward into an outward block, transitioning into an inside sweeping block upward 
4–6s: rotates hips into a straight punch, then shifts weight into a side step with a pushing motion 
6–8s: lifts knee smoothly and extends into a controlled front kick, maintaining balance 
8–10s: steps back into a guarded cover, drops into a low block, then rises into a hook punch 
10–12s: pivots the body with a clean turn, transitioning into a forward palm strike 
12–14s: lowers into a sweeping motion, then rises fluidly into a locking control pose 
14–15s: finishes upright with a respectful closing salute, hands together at chest level 
Movement style is soft, flowing, controlled, with precise martial intention rather than aggression. Emphasis on balance, breath, and continuity. Camera is a steady medium-wide shot with subtle slow tracking, no cuts.\

prompt_en:
Subject: Summer Smile by the Sea

Person/Expression:
A 20s woman. Bright ivory-beige skin with a smooth texture and faint pink complexion. Soft highlights on cheeks, nose, shoulders, and collarbones, leaving natural skin texture without excessive skin correction. Pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink brown gradient eyeshadow, long thin eyelashes, delicate lower lashes, and natural tear bags. Brows are a soft arch in light brown. Lips have transparent pink-beige gloss with a natural shine in the center. Small, clear catchlights in the eyes. Smiling brightly, with the face turned slightly to the left.

Clothing/Pose:
Wearing a cream beige crochet resort dress. Thin shoulder straps, delicate crochet patterns, lace-up style cutouts from waist to hip, and drawstring shearing on the right side. The fabric is a translucent knit that lets light through, but with an elegant inner structure to avoid overexposure. Matching thin-strap sandals on the feet. Leaning the body slightly forward, hands naturally resting on the knees. Knees are slightly bent, creating a soft S-curve in the hip line. Natural movement in the hair and dress hem caught by the sea breeze.

Background/Light:
A coastal promenade in Japan, such as Shonan or Hayama. Blue sea and white railings on the left, green hills in the distance. White buildings, outdoor stairs, and potted plants on the right. Bright clear weather around noon. The sun enters from the upper left, creating soft highlights on the face, shoulders, collarbones, and legs. Railing shadows fall diagonally onto the cobblestones, and reflected light from the sea brightens the shadows on the skin and clothing. The background is bright but not overexposed.

Composition/Camera:
Smartphone vertical screen, 9:16. Full-body Japanese-style photo. The subject is slightly right of center, leaving plenty of blue sky headroom. Including feet, showing sandals and cobblestone shadows. Camera is at a slightly lower height close to eye level, a natural close-range portrait. Natural expansion around 35mm, focus on the person, with a natural, not too shallow bokeh for the sea and buildings.

Texture/Style:
High-quality Japanese realistic photography. Bright, clean summer tones, a refreshing color scheme of white, beige, and blue. Skin is smooth but avoids a plastic feel, carefully depicting each strand of hair, the texture of the crochet, the thin sandal straps, and the texture of the cobblestones.
